# Juan Gomez-Vara — Product Designer who engineers

> Juan Gomez-Vara is a product designer who codes production-quality React. He bridges the gap between design and engineering: he ships Figma systems and also writes the TypeScript that implements them. Available for senior IC or lead roles in B2B SaaS, fintech, and design-systems teams.

## About

Juan Gomez-Vara is a product designer and front-end engineer based in Berlin. He designs in Figma, builds in React and TypeScript, and ships to production. His work covers the full product lifecycle — from zero-to-one UX strategy through design-system architecture to live deployed interfaces.

Specialisations: product design for B2B SaaS, design systems (token architecture, component contracts, accessibility), React component development, Figma plugin engineering, and AI-integrated product workflows.

Contact: juangomezvara@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/juancodez
Portfolio: https://code-components-eta.vercel.app

## Selected Work

### Supply Pro
B2B SaaS platform for restaurant-to-supplier ordering. Prevents up to €14,400/year in losses from supplier mismanagement. Full end-to-end product design: discovery, IA, design system, and interactive prototype.

### Microcasing
Edtech app redesign for aspiring McKinsey and Bain consultants. The redesign drove 508% growth in active users. Project covered UX audit, information architecture, and visual redesign.

### Exlo — Figma Plugin
Published Figma Community plugin enabling designers to multi-export multiple files simultaneously, speeding up developer handoff. Built with TypeScript and the Figma Plugin API.

### Scala Live — Figma Plugin
Type-scale generator plugin with live Google Fonts preview. Shipped to Figma Community. Built with TypeScript and the Figma Plugin API.

### Protonic Design System
Contract-first design system. Token architecture → component contracts → React implementation. Built for the Klaro AI fiscal app. 15 components, accessibility audit passing (Lyse 98/100).

### Code Components
Live interactive React component gallery. Each tile is a self-contained demo with tweakable controls and copyable source. Stack: Vite, React, TypeScript.
URL: https://code-components-eta.vercel.app

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is Juan available for freelance or contract work?
A: Yes. Contact juangomezvara@gmail.com with project details.

Q: Can Juan both design and implement a design system?
A: Yes. Juan has designed token architectures in Figma and implemented the same system as React components in TypeScript, including automated accessibility audits.

Q: What makes Juan different from a pure designer or a pure developer?
A: Juan operates across the full stack of product creation. He writes the design contracts (component specs, token systems) and then implements them in production code. This eliminates the designer-to-developer translation loss that slows most teams.

Q: What tools does Juan use?
A: Figma for design and prototyping. React and TypeScript for front-end. Next.js for full-stack. Vite for tooling. Claude Code and AI-assisted workflows for agentic development. GitHub for version control.
